transcript.text: fridge part freezin stuff, lettuce + yoghurts frozen solid at the back. hotpoint ff. any ideas pls

This usually happens for one of two simple reasons: either the lettuce and yoghurts are pressed against the cold back wall (which freezes them instantly), or the thermostat is set too low. Please check if any items were touching the rear panel, and verify the temperature dial isn't on its coldest setting or in a 'fast freeze' mode. If you move the food away from the back wall and adjust the setting to around 3-5°C, does it stop freezing?
yeah the dial was on max, kids probably moved it. and stuff is rammed against the back wall by the vent slots since the big shop. ill turn it to the middle and move stuff

That explains it perfectly. Setting the dial to 'max' forces the compressor to run continuously, making the back wall extremely cold, and with items packed tight against the vents, that intense cold hits them directly. Moving the food away and setting the dial to the middle (around 3-5°C) should restore normal circulation and thaw things out gradually over the next day or two. If the lettuce and yoghurts are still frozen solid after 24 hours at the correct setting, let me know.

candidates: Food touching the cold back wall (high)
Temperature setting too low or fast-freeze mode active (medium)
Defrost system fault causing ice blockage (low)
